_doc: The safe show: one gantry ride in, both salute, four pairs played one at a time (each from rest, back to rest), a closing salute, then the ride out. Only pairs from the safe list: attack/feint high vs block high, low slash vs the middle block, attack/feint high vs attack/feint high. Run from the studio's Show tab (big STOP there) or: python3 arm/duel_sequence.py sim/safe_show.json

moves.note: B fakes the chop at A's bar (no contact)
A's low slash, right to left, into B's hanging guard
A's high feint meets B's real chop
